Elapsed: 0:00

  • The phone is collecting logs and system dumps (bugreportz). Busy devices often need about 5–15 minutes before data is ready.
  • Keep USB connected; avoid running desktop adb or Android Studio against the same device while this runs.
  • Leaving this browser tab visible can reduce throttling; try not to put the phone in deep sleep.
  • When the device finishes, the ZIP is transferred over WebUSB — large reports add more minutes.
  • The progress bar is only a rough guide; completion is when you see the success message and download size below.
